subject: Biology
title: Body Fluids and Circulation
summary: Blood ek fluid connective tissue hai: plasma (55%) aur formed elements (45%) — RBCs, WBCs aur platelets. Lymph rang-heen fluid hai jo tissue fluid ko waapas blood mein laata hai aur fats le jaata hai.
ABO aur Rh blood group RBCs par antigens se tay hote hain; galat transfusion ya pregnancy mein Rh incompatibility khatarnaak ho sakti hai. Coagulation (clotting) cascade se khoon jamta hai.

Human heart mein chaar chambers aur double circulation hai. Iski dhadkan myogenic hai, SA node (pacemaker) se shuru hoti hai, aur cardiac cycle lagbhag 0.8 s ka hai; cardiac output = stroke volume × heart rate. Iski regulation nodal tissue aur medulla karte hain.
ECG heart ki electrical activity record karta hai (P, QRS, T). Disorders: hypertension, coronary artery disease, angina aur heart failure.

formulas.name: Plasma composition
formulas.formula: 90–92% water, 6–8% proteins (fibrinogen — clotting; globulins — defence; albumins — osmotic balance)

formulas.name: Formed elements counts
formulas.formula: RBC 5–5.5 million/mm³;  WBC 6000–8000/mm³;  platelets 1.5–3.5 lakh/mm³;  haemoglobin 12–16 g/100 mL

formulas.name: RBC facts
formulas.formula: made in red bone marrow; biconcave, no nucleus in most mammals; life span 120 days; destroyed in spleen (graveyard of RBCs)

formulas.name: WBC percentages
formulas.formula: neutrophils 60–65% (phagocytes);  lymphocytes 20–25% (B, T — immunity);  monocytes 6–8% (phagocytes);  eosinophils 2–3% (allergy, infections);  basophils 0.5–1% (histamine, serotonin, heparin)

formulas.name: ABO groups
formulas.formula: A: antigen A, anti-B;  B: antigen B, anti-A;  AB: both antigens, no antibodies (universal recipient);  O: no antigens, both antibodies (universal donor)

formulas.name: Rh incompatibility
formulas.formula: Rh⁻ mother + Rh⁺ foetus → mother makes anti-Rh antibodies → affects the next Rh⁺ foetus (erythroblastosis foetalis);  prevented by anti-Rh antibodies to the mother right after the first delivery

formulas.name: Clotting cascade
formulas.formula: injury → thrombokinase → prothrombin → thrombin (needs Ca²⁺) → fibrinogen → fibrin threads trap blood cells → clot

formulas.name: Double circulation
formulas.formula: pulmonary: right ventricle → pulmonary artery → lungs → pulmonary veins → left atrium;  systemic: left ventricle → aorta → body → venae cavae → right atrium

formulas.name: Conducting system
formulas.formula: SA node (right upper atrium, 70–75 impulses/min, pacemaker) → AV node → bundle of His → right and left bundle branches → Purkinje fibres
formulas.mistake: Heart myogenic hai: impulse heart muscle mein hi shuru hota hai, nerve se nahi — galat mat likhna.

formulas.name: Cardiac cycle
formulas.formula: duration = 60/heart rate ≈ 0.8 s at 72 beats/min;  atrial systole 0.1 s, ventricular systole 0.3 s, joint diastole 0.4 s

formulas.name: Cardiac output
formulas.formula: cardiac output = stroke volume × heart rate ≈ 70 mL × 72 ≈ 5 L/min

formulas.name: Heart sounds
formulas.formula: lub (first): closure of tricuspid and bicuspid (AV) valves;  dub (second): closure of semilunar valves

formulas.name: ECG waves
formulas.formula: P: atrial depolarisation;  QRS: ventricular depolarisation (start of ventricular contraction);  T: ventricular repolarisation (end of systole)
formulas.note: Heart rate = har minute QRS complexes ki sankhya.

examples.title: Cardiac output
examples.problem: Stroke volume 70 mL aur heart rate 72 beats/min. Cardiac output?

examples.title: Ek cycle ki duration
examples.problem: Heart rate 72 beats/min hai. Ek cardiac cycle kitni der ka?

examples.title: Universal donor
examples.problem: Group O ko universal donor kyun kehte hain?
examples.solution: O ke RBCs par A ya B antigens nahi hote, isliye recipient ki antibodies unhe agglutinate nahi karti.

examples.title: Erythroblastosis foetalis
examples.problem: Rh⁻ mahila ka doosra bachcha Rh⁺ hai. Khatra kya hai?
examples.solution: Pehli delivery ke baad bani anti-Rh antibodies placenta paar karke foetus ke RBCs tod deti hain — jaanleva anaemia aur jaundice (erythroblastosis foetalis).

examples.title: Lymph aur fat
examples.problem: Intestine se fats kaunsi vessels absorb karti hain?
examples.solution: Lacteals (villi mein lymph vessels). Lymph fat le jaata hai aur thoracic duct se veins mein khaali hota hai.

examples.title: AV node par heart block
examples.problem: AV node fail ho jaaye to kya hoga?
examples.solution: SA node ke impulses ventricles tak normal tarike se nahi pahunchte; ventricles apni dheemi rate se dhadakte hain (heart block), artificial pacemaker chahiye.

topics.title: Blood platelets and WBCs
topics.explain: Platelets (thrombocytes) bone marrow ke megakaryocytes ke tukde hain aur clotting factors chhodte hain. Inki sankhya ghatne par clotting disorders aur zyada khoon behta hai.

topics.title: Lymph (tissue fluid)
topics.explain: Capillaries se guzarte waqt kuch paani aur chhote solutes tissue spaces mein jaakar interstitial fluid banate hain; isme plasma jaisa hi mineral distribution hota hai. Lymphatic vessels ise ikattha karke badi veins mein waapas laati hain. Lymph mein lymphocytes hote hain.

topics.title: Open and closed circulation
topics.explain: Open: blood khuli jagahon mein pump hota hai (arthropods, molluscs). Closed: blood hamesha vessels mein behta hai (annelids, chordates) — zyada sateek control.

topics.title: Human heart structure
topics.explain: Mesodermal origin, thoracic cavity mein, thoda left jhuka, double-walled pericardium mein band. Interatrial aur interventricular septa; tricuspid (right) aur bicuspid/mitral (left) AV valves; pulmonary artery aur aorta ke openings par semilunar valves.

topics.title: Regulation of cardiac activity
topics.explain: Heart ki activity nodal tissue se auto-regulated hai par medulla oblongata ise modify karta hai: sympathetic nerves rate aur taakat badhaati hain; parasympathetic (vagus) ghataati hain. Adrenal medulla ke hormones cardiac output badhaate hain.

topics.title: Disorders
topics.explain: Hypertension (high blood pressure — heart, brain, kidneys ko nuksaan); coronary artery disease ya atherosclerosis (calcium, fat aur cholesterol jama hokar coronary arteries sankri); angina pectoris (heart muscle ko O₂ kam milne se seene mein dard); heart failure (heart kaafi blood pump nahi kar paata — lungs mein congestion). Cardiac arrest = heart ruk jaana; heart attack = achanak blood ki kami se heart muscle ko nuksaan.

topics.title: Hepatic portal system
topics.explain: Hepatic portal vein intestine ka blood systemic circulation se pehle liver tak le jaati hai. Coronary circulation khud heart muscle ko blood deti hai.

ratta: AB universal recipient;  O universal donor.
P atrial depol.;  QRS ventricular depol.;  T ventricular repol.
Lub = AV valves close;  dub = semilunar valves close.
